name: copm-onchain-analysis
description: Reproducible on-chain audit and analysis of Minteo's COPM (Colombian peso stablecoin) on Polygon and Celo. Scans every event of the contracts via RPC and verifies the scan against on-chain supply.

scripts.audit: npm run scan && npm run holders && npm run rates && npm run aggregate && npm run dashboard && npm run charts && npm run validate
scripts.audit:all: npm run audit:polygon && npm run audit:celo && npm run charts:combined && npm run reports

author: Juan Sebastián Agudelo <juansac.me@gmail.com> (https://github.com/juansacdev)
